Data Analyst.description: Analyze data, clean datasets, write SQL queries, create dashboards, communicate insights, and support decisions with statistics and visualization.
roadmap: Practice SQL joins, aggregations, and window functions using a small local dataset.
Build a Power BI or Tableau dashboard and explain three evidence-based insights.
Practice data cleaning and exploratory analysis with pandas.
Write a short report explaining assumptions, limitations, and recommendations.

Machine Learning Intern.description: Prepare data, engineer features, train and evaluate machine learning models, use Python and scikit-learn, and communicate model limitations.
roadmap: Review Python, pandas, NumPy, and data preprocessing.
Train a baseline regression or classification model with scikit-learn.
Use a train/test split and explain a suitable evaluation metric.
Publish a reproducible project with a README and documented limitations.

Data Scientist.description: Use Python, SQL, statistics, data visualization, machine learning, and experimentation to build analytical models and communicate findings.
roadmap: Strengthen statistics, probability, SQL, and exploratory data analysis.
Complete an end-to-end project with data cleaning, a baseline, and model evaluation.
Practice explaining model assumptions, bias, limitations, and uncertainty.
Create a concise portfolio case study with reproducible code and visualizations.

Frontend Developer.description: Build responsive web interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Git, and API integration, and test usability across devices.
roadmap: Build a responsive multi-page interface with semantic HTML and CSS.
Practice JavaScript fundamentals and asynchronous API requests.
Create a small React application with reusable components.
Deploy a portfolio project and document setup and accessibility decisions.

Backend Developer.description: Develop APIs and server-side services, work with databases, test endpoints, use Git, and understand deployment and application security basics.
roadmap: Build a REST API with input validation and clear error responses.
Practice SQL schema design, queries, and database migrations.
Add automated tests and version control to a small backend project.
Learn environment variables, logging, and secure configuration basics.
